player_prompt.intro:
Iwe mchezaji {player_id} mu SimpleTak.
Pa bodi, mawe anu onseka ngati '{player_stone}' ndi mawe a mkumodzi anu onseka ngati '{opponent_stone}'.

Pa mchezo wanu, chitani seli limodzi iliyopinduka (kwa ile nambari yake) ndi uike mawe wanu kuno.
Koma ife, '[12]' kuika mawe wanu mu seli 12.

Lengo lanu ni kulemekeza njira iliyopinduka ya mawe anu ambayo ikaitana mbali ziwiri za bodi (juu-chisiwa au kushoto-kumanja).

invalid_move.cell_out_of_range: Nambala ya selo yosagwira ntchito {cell_num}. Iyenera kukhala pakati pa 0 ndi {max_board_num}.
invalid_move.cell_already_occupied: Cell {cell_num} ali kale wotanganidwa. Sankhani selo chopanda kanthu.

action.placement: Mchezaji {current_player_id} wakaika chithandizo chake ({symbol}) mu seli {cell_num}.

outcome.winner: Mchezaji {current_player_id} ('{symbol}') wakaika mbali ziwiri za mtambala!
outcome.draw: Bwaloli ladzaza. Zili ngati kuti palibe amene wapambana!
